scope: Planning targets only; no applications submitted, placements promised, vacancy availability certified, or course equivalences assigned.
matchingNote: Interest tags and program matching are GoPlan editorial inferences from described fields, not institutional endorsements or eligibility decisions.

internships.name: Orange Morocco
internships.reason: Orange Morocco explicitly welcomes internship candidates and lists networks, IT, cybersecurity, data, marketing, finance and project management among its fields.
internships.caveat: Choose a currently advertised internship whose study level, duration and location fit your AUI internship requirements. A listing here is a research target, not an offer.

internships.name: OCP Group
internships.reason: OCP describes internships for different specializations and education levels; its career areas include industry, innovation, digital, and sales and marketing.
internships.caveat: Search the current OCP careers portal or its spontaneous-application route. Team, site, academic background and project approval must be confirmed.

internships.name: SQLI Morocco
internships.reason: SQLI Morocco develops digital and e-commerce solutions from Rabat, Oujda and Casablanca. Its 2024 ESG report documents Moroccan intern intake and a PFE training academy.

sources.title: SQLI ESG report 2024
sources.note: Historical 2024 evidence of internship activity, not a current intake announcement.

internships.caveat: The internship evidence is historical. Check for a current student/PFE opening and whether its degree level and duration match your AUI placement.

internships.name: Capgemini Morocco
internships.reason: Capgemini has Moroccan offices and recruitment routes for both technology consulting and engineering; its student and graduate page describes early-career paths across business and technology.
internships.caveat: Moroccan presence and recruitment are verified; an eligible Moroccan internship vacancy is not. The general student page does not establish local program availability.

internships.name: Renault Group / Renault Technologie Maroc
internships.reason: Renault offers student internships across its professions. Its recruitment portal has documented a Tangier engineering internship involving industrial engineering, automation and applied AI.

sources.title: Renault — Tangier engineering internship example
sources.note: Example retrieved through the official recruitment listing; availability may have ended.

internships.caveat: The Tangier role is evidence of a relevant host, not a promise of a current vacancy. Check the live posting and local study-level, language and placement-duration conditions.

internships.name: Schneider Electric
internships.reason: Schneider Electric publishes early-career internships and student development in digital skills, sustainability, supply chain, services, and sales and marketing.

sources.title: Schneider Electric — Early careers
sources.note: Official search-index text verified; direct page returned HTTP 403 during review.

internships.caveat: Filter live openings by internship and country. A global internship program does not establish an opening in Morocco; local eligibility and travel/work permissions depend on the role.

internships.name: Microsoft
internships.reason: Microsoft publishes university internships for current students across technical and other job families.
internships.caveat: Check country-specific eligibility and the individual vacancy, including enrollment/return-to-study rules and work authorization. No location, sponsorship or acceptance is promised.

internships.name: Publicis Groupe
internships.reason: Publicis France has an established student internship and apprenticeship route, with roles across content, creative, media, marketing communications, strategy and data.
internships.caveat: This evidence concerns France. Check internship rather than apprenticeship requirements, language, placement agreement, duration and work permission for each posting.

internships.name: United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)
internships.reason: UNDP advertises development-related internships by program or management area; its fields also include operations, communications, partnerships and monitoring and evaluation.
internships.caveat: Usually eligible in the final bachelor year, during a master, or within one year of graduation. Apply only to a published role; language and timing vary. This is an international organization, not a company.

internships.name: UNICEF
internships.reason: UNICEF offers humanitarian-sector internships for students and recent graduates from different academic backgrounds.
internships.caveat: Minimum age 18; enrolled in a degree or graduated within two years; language and individual vacancy requirements apply. Typical duration is 6–26 weeks. This is an international organization, not a company.

exchanges.name: Technical University of Munich
exchanges.reason: AUI lists TUM in its exchange finder. TUM publishes exchange study routes, with school-specific course and language requirements.

sources.title: AUI Office of International Programs — Exchange finder

exchanges.caveat: The exchange agreement must cover the intended school. Language evidence varies by department; German and/or English may be required. TUM examination periods may overlap AUI semesters.
exchanges.commonCaveat: Confirm the active agreement, nomination route, available places and host eligibility with AUI OIP. Obtain AUI school approval for every transferred course before finalizing the exchange term.

exchanges.name: Universidad Carlos III de Madrid
exchanges.reason: UC3M provides an undergraduate exchange course offer across social sciences, humanities and engineering, with restrictions depending on the exchange route.

sources.title: AUI Office of International Programs — Exchange finder

exchanges.caveat: Check permitted school, teaching language, prerequisites and timetable. Some courses are restricted; the published limit is 30 ECTS per semester. ECTS are not automatically equal to AUI SCH.
exchanges.commonCaveat: Confirm the active agreement, nomination route, available places and host eligibility with AUI OIP. Obtain AUI school approval for every transferred course before finalizing the exchange term.

exchanges.name: University of Eastern Finland
exchanges.reason: UEF offers English-taught courses to incoming exchange students at bachelor and master levels, primarily in their own field and related disciplines.

sources.title: AUI Office of International Programs — Exchange finder
UEF — Courses for exchange students
sources.note: Page last modified 2026-05-19; links to 2026–27 course guide.

exchanges.caveat: Choose one campus for face-to-face courses. Check prerequisites, pass/fail transfer acceptance, and registration capacity. An approved learning agreement does not reserve a course seat.
exchanges.commonCaveat: Confirm the active agreement, nomination route, available places and host eligibility with AUI OIP. Obtain AUI school approval for every transferred course before finalizing the exchange term.

exchanges.name: VSB – Technical University of Ostrava
exchanges.reason: VSB-TUO publishes English-taught exchange courses and a partner-university exchange route.

sources.title: AUI Office of International Programs — Exchange finder

exchanges.caveat: Check faculty course availability, prerequisites, language requirements and current application dates. Tuition arrangements depend on the active exchange agreement; living and travel costs remain to be planned.
exchanges.commonCaveat: Confirm the active agreement, nomination route, available places and host eligibility with AUI OIP. Obtain AUI school approval for every transferred course before finalizing the exchange term.

exchanges.name: UCSI University
exchanges.reason: UCSI publishes a student exchange program and explicitly names Al Akhawayn University among its partners.

sources.title: AUI Office of International Programs — Exchange finder

exchanges.caveat: The current inbound factsheet and faculty course mapping must be obtained before selecting a term. The general partner list does not establish available places, campus, courses or transfer credit.
exchanges.commonCaveat: Confirm the active agreement, nomination route, available places and host eligibility with AUI OIP. Obtain AUI school approval for every transferred course before finalizing the exchange term.

exchanges.name: Montana State University
exchanges.reason: Montana State provides an incoming exchange application route following home-university nomination, with course planning and published academic requirements.

sources.title: AUI Office of International Programs — Exchange finder

exchanges.caveat: The published GPA is 3.0 for direct exchange and 2.75 for ISEP; AUI OIP must confirm which route applies. English evidence, funds, housing and immigration requirements also apply.
exchanges.commonCaveat: Confirm the active agreement, nomination route, available places and host eligibility with AUI OIP. Obtain AUI school approval for every transferred course before finalizing the exchange term.

exchanges.name: Pitzer College
exchanges.reason: Pitzer describes exchange study across liberal arts fields with an emphasis on environmental sustainability, intercultural understanding and social responsibility.

sources.title: AUI Office of International Programs — Exchange finder
Pitzer — Approved programs including AUI exchange

exchanges.caveat: Home nomination and host admission are required. Review English requirements and course access with the advisor; Pitzer course-credit units differ from AUI SCH.
exchanges.commonCaveat: Confirm the active agreement, nomination route, available places and host eligibility with AUI OIP. Obtain AUI school approval for every transferred course before finalizing the exchange term.

exchanges.name: West Virginia University
exchanges.reason: AUI lists West Virginia University; WVU maintains an incoming exchange page with host preparation and orientation information.

sources.title: AUI Office of International Programs — Exchange finder
WVU — Incoming students
sources.note: Official search-index text verified; direct fetch returned a temporary error.

exchanges.caveat: Ask OIP and the host for the current fact sheet, permitted departments, prerequisites, English/GPA conditions and seats. Academic fit is an exploration suggestion, not confirmed equivalence.
exchanges.commonCaveat: Confirm the active agreement, nomination route, available places and host eligibility with AUI OIP. Obtain AUI school approval for every transferred course before finalizing the exchange term.

exchangePolicy.summary: Exchange is generally one semester; study-abroad experiences normally have a one-calendar-year limit. Transfer requires approval by the appropriate AUI school. Criteria differ by program.
exchangePolicy.action: Shortlist a destination now; confirm OIP nomination, active agreement, current offerings and school-approved equivalences before treating exchange courses as degree requirements.

researchNotes: Eight company targets and two separately labeled international organizations cover the represented student interests.
All eight exchange destinations appear in the official AUI OIP exchange finder as of the review date. UCSI and Pitzer also provide reciprocal AUI evidence.
Source pages are linked instead of copying full material. Candidate matching is advisory; data can change after the review date.
No unverified generic institution is presented as an AUI exchange partner.
